subject.title: perf(ci): split straggler bin pairings and drop needless jsdom environments

question: Should OpenClaw accept the additional compact CI fan-out required by the 190-second cap after an exact-head run confirms the expected wall-time improvement?
rationale: The code change is small, but the desired optimization deliberately trades recurring runner capacity for lower feedback latency; that capacity policy cannot be inferred from unit tests alone.

options.title: Confirm capacity with an exact-head timing run
options.body: Attach the resulting compact-bin plan and completed main-push timing, then merge if the measured wall improvement justifies the four additional bins.

options.title: Keep the existing cap
options.body: Decline the added fan-out if current runner capacity or queue behavior makes the expected latency gain uneconomical.

recommendation.title: Confirm capacity with an exact-head timing run
recommendation.body: Attach the resulting compact-bin plan and completed main-push timing, then merge if the measured wall improvement justifies the four additional bins.

likelyOwner.reason: The current proposal and supporting CI timing analysis were authored by steipete.
